description: Register the wallet with Orderly under a broker ID (for example "demo" on testnet). This creates the account record on the exchange and returns the account ID. Requires the wallet address from wallet_create. Ask the user for the broker ID; do not invent one.

address.description: Wallet address (required for AI/scripts, prompts if omitted)

broker_id.description: Broker ID, e.g., "demo" (required for AI/scripts, prompts if omitted)

network.description: Network override for this call. Defaults to ORDERLY_MCP_NETWORK, then the CLI config.

name: wallet_register
title: Register an account (onboarding step 2)
